name.zh: 49 号联邦公路（圣路易斯波托西—托雷翁—希门尼斯城）

aka.en: Carretera San Luis Potosí–Zacatecas (the southern segment)
aka.zh: 圣路易斯波托西—萨卡特卡斯公路（南段）

aka.en: Carretera Zacatecas–Torreón; Autopista Gómez Palacio–Corralitos (the tolled 49D)
aka.zh: 萨卡特卡斯—托雷翁公路；戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯高速（收费路 49D）

tagline.en: A diagonal across the northern plateau from San Luis Potosí to the Chihuahua line, in two pieces either side of Zacatecas, and a link in the road from Mexico City to Ciudad Juárez
tagline.zh: 斜贯北部高原的公路：从圣路易斯波托西到奇瓦瓦州境，在萨卡特卡斯两侧分为两段，是墨西哥城通往华雷斯城道路上的一环

start.en: San Luis Potosí, at the north-western edge of the city on the road out to Mexquitic de Carmona
start.zh: 圣路易斯波托西市西北边缘，通往梅斯基蒂克德卡尔莫纳的出城路上

end.en: Ciudad Jiménez, Chihuahua, at the junction with Federal Highway 45 and the toll road 45D
end.zh: 奇瓦瓦州希门尼斯城，与 45 号联邦公路及收费路 45D 交会处

en: Federal Highway 49 is in two pieces. The southern runs north-west from San Luis Potosí through Mexquitic de Carmona and Salinas de Hidalgo across the Zacatecas line to Las Arcinas, on Highway 45 south-east of Zacatecas. The northern leaves Highway 45 north-west of Fresnillo and runs through Río Grande and Juan Aldama to Cuencamé in Durango, shares the road with Highway 40 for 104.6 km to Gómez Palacio, across the river from Torreón, and continues north by Bermejillo, Ceballos and Escalón to Ciudad Jiménez in Chihuahua.

English Wikipedia, from the 2011 road data, gives 526.7 km for the northern segment and 162.98 km for the southern, 689.68 km in all; Spanish Wikipedia counts 600 km in three sections. Between the two, traffic uses Highway 45 through Zacatecas and Fresnillo.

The road is part of the long route from Mexico City to Ciudad Juárez by way of San Luis Potosí. A 2003 environmental statement for its widening said that about 80 per cent of that route already had four lanes or more, and that the two-lane gaps, this among them, were where crashes concentrated.
zh: 49 号联邦公路分为两段。南段自圣路易斯波托西向西北，经梅斯基蒂克德卡尔莫纳和萨利纳斯德伊达尔戈越过萨卡特卡斯州界，到达萨卡特卡斯东南 45 号公路上的拉斯阿尔西纳斯。北段在弗雷斯尼略西北离开 45 号公路，经里奥格兰德和胡安阿尔达马到达杜兰戈州的昆卡梅，与 40 号公路共线 104.6 公里至托雷翁对岸的戈麦斯帕拉西奥，再向北经贝尔梅希略、塞瓦略斯和埃斯卡隆抵达奇瓦瓦州希门尼斯城。
英语维基百科依据 2011 年道路数据，给出北段 526.7 公里、南段 162.98 公里，合计 689.68 公里；西班牙语维基百科则分三段计为 600 公里。两段之间，车辆经由 45 号公路穿过萨卡特卡斯和弗雷斯尼略。
这条路是墨西哥城经圣路易斯波托西通往华雷斯城的长途线路的一部分。2003 年一份拓宽工程环境影响报告称，这条线路约 80% 的长度已有四条或更多车道，而包括本路在内的双车道缺口正是事故集中的地方。

en: The northern line belongs to the trunk network completed in the 1940s. The sociologist Ovidio González Gómez counts among that decade's main works the link between Zacatecas and Chihuahua, which also joined Durango and Parral to Chihuahua, Zacatecas and Torreón.

The tolled line north of Torreón came with the private-concession programme of the early 1990s. The Gómez Palacio–Corralitos road was conceded on 27 October 1993 to the government of Durango, for 184 km by the construction chamber CMIC's count, and began operating on 4 November 1994. It was one of the 23 concessions the federal government took back by a decree published in the Diario Oficial on 27 August 1997, in force from 1 September. On 30 September 2011 it was placed under a sixty-year concession to FONADIN, the national infrastructure fund, which lists it at 150.59 km; CAPUFE operates it, with plazas at Bermejillo and Ceballos.

The southern segment was rebuilt in the 2000s. In 2003 the transport ministry filed plans to add a second two-lane carriageway on the 42 km from the San Luis Potosí–Zacatecas line to Las Arcinas, a straight stretch it described as prone to crashes from night-time glare and high speeds, with patches of fog; in 2005 it added a 5.4 km bypass of Mexquitic de Carmona, at kilometre 22. On 6 February 2012 President Felipe Calderón inaugurated the finished 153.4 km four-lane road at Salinas de Hidalgo, saying it cut the journey from two and a half hours to an hour and a half.
zh: 北段属于 1940 年代建成的干线路网。社会学家奥维迪奥·冈萨雷斯·戈麦斯把萨卡特卡斯与奇瓦瓦之间的连接线列为那十年的主要工程之一，这条线还把杜兰戈和帕拉尔与奇瓦瓦、萨卡特卡斯和托雷翁连在一起。

托雷翁以北的收费线路出现于 1990 年代初的私营特许计划。戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯公路于 1993 年 10 月 27 日特许给杜兰戈州政府，据墨西哥建筑业商会（CMIC）统计长 184 公里，1994 年 11 月 4 日开始运营。1997 年 8 月 27 日《联邦官方日报》刊登法令，联邦政府收回 23 项特许经营权，该路即在其中，法令自 9 月 1 日起生效。2011 年 9 月 30 日，该路以六十年特许交由国家基础设施基金（FONADIN），该基金登记长度为 150.59 公里；由 CAPUFE 运营，在贝尔梅希略和塞瓦略斯设有收费站。

南段在 2000 年代重建。2003 年，交通部提交方案，在圣路易斯波托西—萨卡特卡斯州界至拉斯阿尔西纳斯的 42 公里路段上加建第二幅双车道路面；它称这段直路因夜间眩光和高速行驶而事故频发，且有雾区。2005 年又增加了位于 22 公里处、长 5.4 公里的梅斯基蒂克德卡尔莫纳绕城路。2012 年 2 月 6 日，费利佩·卡尔德龙总统在萨利纳斯德伊达尔戈为建成的 153.4 公里四车道公路揭幕，称行程由两个半小时缩短到一个半小时。

en: The 2012 modernisation of San Luis Potosí–Zacatecas was federally funded at 2,000 million pesos, 65 km of it in Zacatecas. The Gómez Palacio–Corralitos toll road is paid for from its tolls under the FONADIN concession, which runs to 30 September 2071.

In 2026 the ministry resurfaced the Zacatecas–Torreón road in two stages, as reported in the Zacatecas press: a first of 42.2 km in Fresnillo and Río Grande, reported in June at 107 million pesos, and a second of 24.06 km between Rancho Grande and the Durango line, reported in July at 80.4 million.
zh: 2012 年圣路易斯波托西—萨卡特卡斯段的改造由联邦出资 20 亿比索，其中 65 公里位于萨卡特卡斯州。戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯收费路在国家基础设施基金特许下以通行费偿付，特许期至 2071 年 9 月 30 日。
据萨卡特卡斯当地媒体报道，2026 年交通部分两期重铺萨卡特卡斯—托雷翁公路：第一期 42.2 公里位于弗雷斯尼略和里奥格兰德，6 月报道投资 1.07 亿比索；第二期 24.06 公里位于兰乔格兰德至杜兰戈州界之间，7 月报道投资 8,040 万比索。

value.en: 689.68 km: 526.7 km for the northern segment and 162.98 km for the southern, from the 2011 Datos Viales, as cited in English Wikipedia; Spanish Wikipedia gives 600 km in three sections
value.zh: 689.68 公里：北段 526.7 公里、南段 162.98 公里，出自 2011 年《道路数据》，据英语维基百科引述；西班牙语维基百科分三段计为 600 公里

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 49; Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 49

why.en: No public figure for the original road, built as part of the northern trunk network in the 1940s; the modern section costs are given below.
why.zh: 1940 年代作为北部干线路网一部分修建的原有公路无公开数据；现代各段造价见下文。

figures.source: La Jornada Zacatecas, 5 June and 29 July 2026; EcoDiario, 28 July 2026

timeline.en: The Gómez Palacio–Corralitos toll road is conceded to the government of Durango on 27 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯收费路特许给杜兰戈州政府。

timeline.en: The toll road begins operating on 4 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 4 日，该收费路开始运营。

timeline.en: A decree in the Diario Oficial of 27 August takes the toll road back into federal hands.
timeline.zh: 8 月 27 日《联邦官方日报》刊登法令，将该收费路收归联邦。

timeline.en: The ministry files plans to widen the last two-lane stretch to Las Arcinas.
timeline.zh: 交通部提交方案，拓宽通往拉斯阿尔西纳斯的最后一段双车道。

timeline.en: A 5.4 km bypass of Mexquitic de Carmona is added to the project.
timeline.zh: 工程增加长 5.4 公里的梅斯基蒂克德卡尔莫纳绕城路。

timeline.en: Gómez Palacio–Corralitos passes to FONADIN under a sixty-year concession on 30 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯以六十年特许交由国家基础设施基金。

timeline.en: Felipe Calderón inaugurates the four-lane San Luis Potosí–Zacatecas road on 6 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 6 日，费利佩·卡尔德龙为四车道圣路易斯波托西—萨卡特卡斯公路揭幕。

timeline.en: The ministry resurfaces 66 km of the Zacatecas–Torreón road in two stages.
timeline.zh: 交通部分两期重铺萨卡特卡斯—托雷翁公路共 66 公里。
